claims.quote: The improved 'limitless-distance' telephone was presently introduced, and the daily doings of the globe made visible to everybody
claims.description: A telephone link that shows live video of distant places anywhere on the globe, so world events are visible to everyone.

claims.quote: it was delivered to public use, and was soon connected with the telephonic systems of the whole world
claims.description: A telelectroscope, a device for seeing distant places, is linked into the world's telephone networks for public use.

claims.quote: the day will never come when it will do a farthing's worth of real service for any human being
claims.description: A skeptic insists the telelectroscope will never be useful to anyone.

claims.quote: under the new paragraph added to the Constitution in 1889, second trials are not State affairs, but national
claims.description: A fictional constitutional amendment moves second criminal trials from state courts to the national Supreme Court.

claims.quote: I resume by cable-telephone where I left off yesterday
claims.description: Long-distance news reporting sent by a cable telephone link rather than by letter or telegraph.

claims.quote: To-day, by a clipper of the Electric Line
claims.description: Electrically powered transport network that carries mail and freight across the ocean and inland by electric railway.
